recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing current-build source changes for FHIR-40341 without reopening the already reconciled FHIR-41688 generic Range/composite decision. Handle any future resource-specific Range composites or exclude-in-composite behavior under separate Jira issues with explicit approval.
issue_request: FHIR-40341 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 by FHIR-I. It requested Group search support for characteristic valueQuantity/valueRange and exclude semantics; the final resolution required adding Range as an allowed quantity search target, fixing the type-mapping links, adding explicit Range examples for prefixes, and clarifying canonical-unit limitations.
initial_application: A prior untrailed source commit, 56d9a2058dcb78d38d8d3e29b28ab83f2f6bb4ba, added Group quantity/exclude search parameters plus some search-page text. Current source still lacked Range in the quantity type-mapping row, left the left-column search-type links pointing to datatypes, had an incorrect explicit Range upper-bound example, and retained two directly coupled Group search-parameter defects: a malformed characteristic-reference component expression and a Group-quantity URL that duplicated Group-value.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2025-04-14 confirm the 9-0-0 motion and explicitly relate FHIR-40341 to FHIR-41688 for more detailed Range support. Zulip discussions show the Group.characteristic.valueRange use case and the later generic FHIR-41688 composite-search path. FHIR-41688 is already represented separately on the combined branch and was treated as related context, not a duplicate decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html to link search-type names to their search sections, list Range under the quantity search type, and correct the explicit Range example upper bound from 2.50000000000000000000 to 2.30000000000000000000. Updated source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml so Group-characteristic-reference has a valid value.ofType(Reference) component expression and Group-quantity has the canonical URL SearchParameter/Group-quantity.
source_changes: source/search.html: added Range to the quantity row of the Search Types and FHIR Types table, changed the left-column search-type links to same-page search anchors, and corrected the explicit Range decimal upper-bound example.
source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml: fixed the characteristic-reference component FHIRPath expression and corrected the Group-quantity canonical URL.
